name: concept journal
wording: The project's append-only record of its design and decisions, kept with the project and starting empty: the current design and the open decisions are computed from it, the latest version of each concept or context description being current, and two versions superseding the same one compete until a later one supersedes both. With the ledger it is the project's one event-sourced record, the design stream beside the work stream; the examples are documents kept beside it. A change's entries are recorded on that change's own branch and arrive with its merge. It warns, never refuses, where a wording names an implementation, cites a decision, recounts history, or only extends the version it replaces.
reason: Where design is recorded belonged to no one, and an architect recorded a change's design onto the shared line of work; a change's entries belong on its own branch.
